test_title: PYST 34 - SSC CHSL 2025 - Quantitative Aptitude (Held On: 25 Nov, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: maths
question: Meena took a loan of Rs. 8,000 at 10% compound interest per annum for 3 years. She repaid Rs. 4,000 at the end of the 1st year and the rest at the end of the 3rd year. Find the total interest paid by Meena.
solution:
**Given:**

Loan amount = Rs. 8000

Rate of compound interest per annum = 10%

Duration = 3 years

Repayment after 1st year = Rs. 4000

Repayment after 3rd year = Remaining amount

**Formula Used:**

Compound Interest = Principal × (1 + Rate/100)Time - Principal

**Calculation:**

⇒ Amount after 1st year = 8000 × (1 + 10/100)¹

⇒ Amount after 1st year = 8000 × 1.1 = 8800

⇒ Interest for 1st year = 8800 - 8000 = 800

⇒ Remaining principal after 1st repayment = 8800 - 4000 = 4800

⇒ Amount after 3rd year = 4800 × (1 + 10/100)²

⇒ Amount after 3rd year = 4800 × 1.1² = 4800 × 1.21 = 5808

⇒ Interest for 2nd and 3rd year = 5808 - 4800 = 1008

⇒ Total interest = 800 + 1008 = 1808

**∴ The correct answer is Rs. 1808.**
